gloss: highlight, best scene, moment to shine

definitions.explanation: The most impressive or exciting part of a performance, event, game, or situation. Originally a theater term for the climactic scene, now used broadly for any moment that grabs attention.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見|み}せ{場|ば}だ。
⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見|み}せ{場|ば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They created a highlight in the second half and made a comeback.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{派手|はで}→派手：03563_hade⟧な⟦アクション→アクション：10749_akushon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見|み}せ{場|ば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{飽|あ}き→飽きる：01815_akiru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: This movie has many flashy action highlights, so you can enjoy it without getting bored until the end.

notes:
USAGE:
{見|み}せ{場|ば} comes from ⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ (to show) + ⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧ (scene, place). Originally a theatrical term for the climactic or most dramatically effective scene, it is now widely used for sports, presentations, performances, and everyday situations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見|み}せ{場|ば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (create a highlight, make a moment to shine)
- {見|み}せ{場|ば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (no highlight, no moment to shine)
- ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見|み}せ{場|ば} (the biggest highlight)
- {見|み}せ{場|ば}⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧ (full of highlights)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ハイライト: highlight (loanword, used similarly but more casual)
- ⟦{見|み}どころ→見どころ：10616_midokoro⟧: highlight, point of interest (things worth seeing, often for tourism or events)
- ⟦クライマックス→クライマックス：10874_kuraimakkusu⟧: climax (loanword, specifically the peak of dramatic tension)
